meta.title: Pulaski County — the money trail
meta.note: This is the county's 2026 budget as filed with the state: Budget Ordinance No. 25-OR-52 and the annual budget it adopts. Fund amounts are the ordinance's "Appropriation" lines; departments and their salary and "M&O" (maintenance and operations) totals come from the budget pages. Some funds pay for work in other funds, so a few dollars may be counted twice.
